+import jdk.test.lib.apps.LingeredApp;
+
+
+public class LingeredAppForDebuginfoTest extends LingeredApp {
+
+    static {
+        System.loadLibrary("DebuginfoTest");
+    }
+
+    public static native void callSleep();
+
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        Thread.ofPlatform().start(LingeredAppForDebuginfoTest::callSleep);
+        LingeredApp.main(args);
+    }
+}
